summary: Primary implementation-family classification for all round-009 roadmap candidates. Each roadmap pattern appears in exactly one primary group.

groups.title: Form and document output
verifier_strategy: new rows are included in totals
formula cells remain unchanged
required metadata is populated
printable region contains expected summary values
groups.notes: This group is the cleanest first fixture family because document-style outputs expose row growth, formula preservation, and printable verification in one bounded workbook surface.

groups.title: Period roll-forward and locked summaries
common_mechanics: planned versus actual or period totals
verifier_strategy: next period exists with expected labels
input cells clear while formulas remain
previous balances or roster bands carry forward when expected
summary totals include the new period
groups.notes: These patterns stress the same period-copy and formula-preservation behavior across finance, education, and HR.

groups.title: Transaction and reconciliation control
verifier_strategy: matched rows reconcile by key
missing or mismatched rows are reported separately
stock or reorder flags reflect threshold rules
lookup-enriched fields preserve source identity
groups.notes: This group is high-value but needs fixtures with explicit positive and negative reconciliation cases.

groups.title: Schedule and grid propagation
verifier_strategy: date spans map to the expected grid or phase region
new tasks or shifts inherit formulas and validations
status summaries update after row changes
timeline or phase output remains bounded to the chosen workbook shape
groups.notes: Use this group after period-roll-forward fixtures because timeline and grid outputs need stronger visual or structural checks.

groups.title: Dense matrix and scored summary control
verifier_strategy: new columns or rows preserve scoring formulas
weighted summary values match source scores
protected totals remain unchanged
completion or score status updates after entry changes
groups.notes: This group is verifier-heavy because row and column growth both matter.

groups.title: Status pipeline and review workflow
verifier_strategy: status values are constrained
open overdue or high-risk rows are flagged
owner and status summaries update from row changes
queue-first patterns do not drift into intake-form-only behavior
groups.notes: This group turns workflow-heavy evidence into row-state and summary verification rather than generic project management.

groups.title: Calculation schedule with protected formulas
verifier_strategy: schedule rows preserve formula structure
protected formula cells are not overwritten
changed assumptions update dependent totals
invalid numeric assumptions are rejected
groups.notes: This is a useful formula-tracing fixture, but it is narrower than the cross-domain groups above.
